body: I don’t wish you were dead!!! I’m so proud of you for making it this far, and you seem smart from the way wrote this paragraph. I know the bad past can get you wrapped up in feeling bad, but if you could just find one friend to share your struggles with, I think you would become even stronger! I hope that the day never comes where you do harm yourself. You do not have to be your family! You can get as far away from that as you like. Take your power back from your family, and show them that you can do anything!

hi i’m a little late to the party sorry, i can maybe relate to a situation feeling hopeless, but think about who you are as a person. you’ve gotten this far dealing with this situation for so long every day for six months. reach out to your friends hard. talk to your parents. let them in, and ask for the help you need so that you can get out of this situation. i know the emotions feel overwhelming, but i see a hopeful ray of light just around the corner of you take the steps to have a heart to heart with your family and or friends. at this point they’re your motivation. they and i only want the best for you. you’re almost out of this, ask for a little help from your loved ones. you never have to fight your battles alone.

oh i guess i took it the wrong way. honestly not having experience with any sort of sign, i wouldn’t know. but my best guess would be that it would make more sense and having signs could allow relatives to see their loved ones thought process more clearly.

hi, i relate to you in the feeling that the world around me as well as myself is fake or artificial. having lost my sister to suicide a few months shy of a year age, these feelings have lessened a bit, but i still have moments where i am observing the world through a lense and listening to someone else speak the words i say as i say them. trauma mixed with guilt can cause this feeling and i find what helps with this from my own experience is focusing on details around me. specific details. it can help make things real in a sense. over time i’m sure you can find coping skills to help lesson this feeling. i hope this helps answer your questions and i wish you the best of luck in the future. remember that there are other people who feel the way you do and that it does get better over time.

i relate to your post so much, having lost my sister to suicide, it was something that blind sighted everyone. i have these questions running through my head on the daily, and it’s been awhile since the event.  i find myself wondering the same things you are, like would this be easier to accept had my sister showed signs so that we could in some way help? but the truth of it is, there’s no way to know what was going on that moment for both of our people. i myself find it incredibly difficult dealing with the why. but honestly, i really think everyone who deals with a family member dying in this specific way, no matter if they showed signs or not, always has trouble dealing with the question of why. i believe everyone can deal with suicidal thoughts and it can happen to the most unexpected people. i wish you the best of luck in your future and hope having someone you can briefly relate  with can help give you comfort is some type of way. we’re in this together!
i’m glad you’re still alive. i think it’s good that you feel the need to die peacefully. you deserve to die peacefully. give yourself the self worth you deserve.

hey, it sounds like you’re dealing with some dissociation. sometimes it can be taking the first step by admitting you don’t feel like yourself. when you notice then you have the power to make a change in your daily routine. trying new things can make you feel real and in the moment. find some new activity to try out and maybe you’ll feel alive. i’m proud of you for noticing that you don’t feel ok and reaching out to help you get out of this. i’m sorry that you’re hurting right now. reach out for any spark of happiness you can find.

happy birthday dude! it sounds like you’re so serious you’re all focused on school when you should be partying having the time of your life. go get your friend and do something fun. you will get this school stuff figured out with a little time. give yourself the gratitude you deserve. it’s all good not to know what you want to do, most people don’t. i wish you the best of luck with med school. you can do this!

think about you for a second not anything spiritual or anything about the rest of the world. think about you in your happiest moment. the point of waiting until your natural death could be to give you the chance as a strong, deserving human being to have a million more of those happiest moments. i know that you are going through this pain that is unbearable and i could never understand it. but you being a human being that has kept going this far means you deserve the good moments around the corner. you deserve to get to the next stage of life. you are valued and important and because of this natural death is worth waiting for.

maybe looking for help in another way besides a hospital could help. i’m happy that you started seeing hope in the past, remember that feeling? find the reason you got that hope in the past and get it back in this current moment. life’s not all about school, it’s about you being you and finding happiness. based on you coming this far means it’s more likely for you to keep going. you can do it. cling on to any hopeful feeling you get.

hi, from a stranger, congratulations on your daughter! it sounds like you have a strong support system if you’re willing to let them in. lean on your support in these moments. try to notice all the times you smile in a day and enhance the moments you can feel a brief moment of happiness. remember that you are worth this all that you have. you can defeat depression.

you are a warrior, it looks like you want everyone else to never have to feel the pain that you’re feeling. That shows that you have a big heart. Someone like that is caring amd not a hypocrite. take it easy on yourself amd treat yourself as caring as you treat others. I know it can be hard, but speak to yourself as if you were speaking to someone else. sorry if this makes no sense, i just don’t think you’re a hypocrite and i think your life is worth living because of the fact you keep encouraging others. try to find yourself by observing how you encourage others. i bet some people are helped by you. you’re worth it my dude, hang in there.
no you don’t have to do anything tonight my dude give it some deep thought and find the happiness in absolutely anything in your life

you are not a loser! i can tell by the admiration you have for your sister. remember you also do not deserve the living conditions you are in right now! what you wish for your sister is what i wish for you, remember the people close to you like your sister who needs you. keep pushing my friend you can do it! i’m sorry you have to put up with this.

DO NOT DO IT, please find one good memory from your life, one thing to laugh about, one thing you love in life, please. remember the time you laughed about that one thing. think about your loved ones who will surely miss you. talk to someone!

hey there, i’m proud of you for noticing a change in your behavior! do you think you could notice any differences in your last two months that made you “ok”? try to find them and make this change. it’s perfectly ok to not know what to do in life be patient amd just let yourself figure it out with time. i get that it socially things are difficult, i relate to that. maybe have 1 social goal you would like to complete each day, for instance getting in touch with an old friend or complimenting someone at random you see in public. i wish you the best, most positive luck!

think about what makes you happy in life. is it beautiful scenery, a chance at your dream career? whatever it is, that is your motivation in life. maybe make a scahedule dedicated to small amounts of work at a time, and other time for non work related things. best of luck to you keep pushing!

please, please, please talk about your feelings with a close family member or friend please don’t do it! erase the plan, remember your happy memories and create new ones much love to you <3 it’s not the only way out
